summary: fix(design-tokens): address Nova token review feedback
description:
Because:
- Review flagged a design-guide crash, a stale comment, a theme/OS mismatch, and a missing test on the Nova token PR.

This commit:
- Resolve function-valued Tailwind colors in the Colors design guide so it renders
- Sync Nova color-scheme to the app's .dark class instead of the OS
- Correct the palette source comment to name the real token files
- Test __NOVA_THEME__ replacement in both settings serving paths
